reduced_contract.inclination_effect: For fixed projected speed and otherwise fixed geometry, deprojection scales as1/sin(i); local fractional sensitivity is−cot(i) delta_i with delta_i in radians. This formula does not control warp-induced radius reassignment or pressure/state effects. No numeric propagation performed.
reduced_contract.random_errors: If justified marginal standard deviations become admitted, mean SD<=sum sigma_j/12 under arbitrary correlations. No independence or Gaussian assumption from missing covariance.
reduced_contract.do_not_sum_contrasts: The method/side discrepancies share observations and geometry; neither independent quadrature addition nor treating their sum as a comprehensive error bound is justified.
